question: Which article of the constitution states that no person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to a procedure established by law?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 21.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Articles 12-35 **of the Indian Constitution deal with **Fundamental Rights.**
 
• These human rights are conferred upon the** citizens of India **for the Constitution tells that these rights are inviolable.
